text: The following agencies have submitted 2021 Financial Statements and related documents for the year ended December 31, 2021 to the Audit Committee for consideration: - Exhibition Place - Heritage Toronto - TO Live - Toronto Parking Authority - Toronto Public Library - Toronto Transit Commission - Toronto Zoo - Yonge-Dundas Square

City Council on July 19, 20, 21 and 22, 2022, adopted the following: 1. City Council receive the 2021 Financial Statements and related documents for the year ended December 31, 2021 from the following City of Toronto Agencies for information: a. Exhibition Place; b. Heritage Toronto; c. TO Live; d. Toronto Parking Authority; e. Toronto Public Library; f. Toronto Transit Commission; g. Toronto Zoo; and h. Yonge-Dundas Square
